name: bow-tie
description: A bow tie with two broad folded wings and a central knot.
useCase: Identify bow ties or formal neckwear in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: Two open folded wings meet the broad central knot.

24.reason: The larger bow keeps its central knot and both folded wings open.
